title: Base and module comparison for canonical localized approximation colimits
statement: Let R→S be commutative rings and M an S-module with its restricted R-action. Let a nonempty directed preorder index compatible diagrams A→B and D of B_i-modules, with supplied ring and additive-group colimit cocones to common-universe ULifts of R, S and M [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Assume the cocone ring square commutes and all original module transitions and coprojections are semilinear. For a prime q of S [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], contract q along ULift.down to q′, and form the explicit fraction diagrams A_l=primeRingDiagram A (η≫κ) q′, B_l=primeRingDiagram B κ q′, D_l=primeModuleDiagram B κ q′ D hs [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Given a ring map ψ:colimit A_l→colimit B_l and a colimit B_l-module action on colimit D_l, assume ψ agrees with the localized stage ring maps on coprojections and the localized module coprojections are semilinear for that action. Then there is ρ:R→colimit A_l making colimit A_l an IsLocalization at the complement of q∩R. For the R-action on colimit D_l restricted first through ψ and then through ρ, there is an R-linear equivalence M_q ≃ colimit D_l. No locality, stage numerator-map, or stage module-comparison conclusion is part of this theorem.

proof.text: Use the supplied ring colimit cocones to compare A and B with their chosen colimits. Contract q along ULift.down and the cocone maps. Apply filtered-colimit localization at a prime to each ring diagram and transport through the supplied colimit isomorphisms and the ULift ring equivalences. The compatible original ring square identifies the base prime with q∩R. This gives colimit A_l ≅ R_(q∩R) and colimit B_l ≅ S_q as ring comparisons, characterized by their numerator formulas.

The canonical fraction maps D_l,i→M_q are induced by ULift.down composed with ν_i. They are well defined by semilinearity and contracted denominators. Cocone naturality holds on fractions. To lift m/s in M_q, lift m using the original additive colimit and s using the top ring colimit, then move both to a common stage. Since the image of the lifted denominator is s∉q, its stage denominator is outside the contracted prime. Thus every fraction has a stage representative.

If two stage fractions have equal image, first move to a common stage and write them x/s and y/t. Equality in M_q gives u∉q killing t·ν(x)−s·ν(y). Lift u to the top ring diagram, pass to a common later stage, and descend the zero relation in the supplied additive colimit by eventual equality. The lifted u remains outside every contracted prime. At that later stage the fraction relation holds, so the two fractions coincide. The elementwise filtered-colimit criterion, applied over ℤ to the additive groups, proves that this fraction cocone is a colimit and gives the additive comparison colimit D_l ≅ M_q.

The supplied ψ has the coprojection formula, so after the ring comparisons it equals the canonical R_(q∩R)→S_q map by uniqueness of the ring-colimit mediator. Likewise any scalar and any module element can be lifted to a common localized stage. Their product is therefore determined by the supplied semilinearity equation, which identifies act with the fraction multiplication action of S_q after the additive comparison. Compose the inverse base ring comparison with R→R_(q∩R) to obtain ρ and its IsLocalization witness. The inverse additive comparison M_q→colimit D_l is R-linear because the original R-action is restricted from S by IsScalarTower, ψ matches the canonical localized ring map, and ρ matches R→R_(q∩R). This is the claimed linear equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem canonical_localized_approximation_limit
    (R : Type u) (S : Type v) (M : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module S M] [IsScalarTower R S M] :
    let R' := ULift.{max u v w} R
    let S' := ULift.{max u v w} S
    let M' := ULift.{max u v w} M
    letI : Algebra R' S' := ULift.algebra' R S'
    ∀
    {Λ : Type (max u v w)} [Preorder Λ] [Nonempty Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)]
    (A B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{max u v w}) (η : A ⟶ B)
      (π : A ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of R'))
      (κ : B ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (CommRingCat.of S'))
      (D : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})
      (ν : D ⟶ (Functor.const Λ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M'))
    [∀ i : Λ, Module (B.obj i) (D.obj i)]
    (hmodel :
      -- (1) the three colimits, compatible with `R' → S'` and the module actions
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R') π)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of S') κ)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (AddCommGrpCat.of M') ν)) ∧
      (∀ i, η.app i ≫ κ.app i = π.app i ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R' S')) ∧
      (∀ (i j : Λ) (h : i ≤ j) (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom (y • x) =
          (B.map (homOfLE h)).hom y • (D.map (homOfLE h)).hom x) ∧
      (∀ i (y : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i),
        (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M') (ν.app i)) (y • x) =
          (@CommRingCat.Hom.hom _ (CommRingCat.of S') (κ.app i)) y •
            (@AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom _ (AddCommGrpCat.of M') (ν.app i)) x))
    (q : PrimeSpectrum S),
    let q' : PrimeSpectrum S' := ⟨q.asIdeal.comap ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom,
      Ideal.IsPrime.comap _⟩
    let hs := fun (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : D.obj i) ↦
      hmodel.2.2.2.2.1 i j (leOfHom f) b x
    let Aₗ := primeRingDiagram A (η ≫ κ) q'
    let Bₗ := primeRingDiagram B κ q'
    let Dₗ := primeModuleDiagram B κ q' D hs
    ∀ (ψ : (colimit Aₗ : CommRingCat.{max u v w}) →+*
        (colimit Bₗ : CommRingCat.{max u v w}))
      (act : Module (colimit Bₗ : CommRingCat.{max u v w})
        (colimit Dₗ : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})),
      letI := act
      (∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι Aₗ i).hom =
        (colimit.ι Bₗ i).hom.comp (primeDiagramHom A B η κ q' i)) →
      (∀ (i : Λ) (b : Bₗ.obj i) (x : Dₗ.obj i),
        (colimit.ι Dₗ i).hom (b • x) =
          (colimit.ι Bₗ i).hom b • (colimit.ι Dₗ i).hom x) →
      (∃ ρ : R →+* (colimit Aₗ : CommRingCat.{max u v w}),
        letI := ρ.toAlgebra
        letI := Module.compHom (colimit Dₗ : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}) ψ
        letI := Module.compHom (colimit Dₗ : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w}) ρ
        IsLocalization (q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap R S)).primeCompl
          (colimit Aₗ : CommRingCat.{max u v w}) ∧
        Nonempty (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl M ≃ₗ[R]
          (colimit Dₗ : AddCommGrpCat.{max u v w})))
